title.en: winter wonders opens on the grand-place.

line.en: the christmas market opens with a tree lighting and a sound-and-light show at 18:00. the square is free to walk; the chalets run until early january.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt öffnet um 18 uhr mit baumbeleuchtung und licht-und-ton-show. der platz ist frei zugänglich; die hütten laufen bis anfang januar.
line.tr: noel pazarı 18:00'de ağaç ışıklandırma ve ışık-ses gösterisiyle açılıyor. meydan ücretsiz gezilebilir; kulübeler ocak başına kadar açık.

sparks.why: Winter Wonders inauguration on the Grand-Place, Fri 27 Nov 18:00, with tree lighting and show (brussels.be, winter-wonders-2026-opening); chalet hours not confirmed.
